gloss: to score (a point); to score (in a game)

definitions.gloss: to score; to gain a point; to earn points
definitions.explanation: To earn one or more points in a game, match, or test.

examples.japanese: {後半|こうはん}に{得点|とくてん}した。
examples.english: They scored in the second half.

examples.japanese: {先制|せんせい}{得点|とくてん}を{挙|あ}げたのはホームチームだった。
examples.english: It was the home team that scored the first point.

examples.japanese: テストで{高|たか}い{得点|とくてん}を{取|と}るために{毎日|まいにち}{勉強|べんきょう}している。
examples.english: I study every day to get a high score on the test.

notes:
{得点|とくてん}する combines {得|とく} (gain) and {点|てん} (point). As a verb, it means to score in a game; as a noun, it means the score or points earned. It is used for sports, games, and tests.

USAGE:
- {得点|とくてん}する: to score (intransitive)
- {得点|とくてん}を{挙|あ}げる: to score a point (more formal)
- {得点|とくてん}を{取|と}る: to earn points / get a score

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {先制|せんせい}{得点|とくてん}: opening score; first point
- {最高|さいこう}{得点|とくてん}: highest score
- {合計|ごうけい}{得点|とくてん}: total score
- {得点|とくてん}{王|おう}: top scorer
- {得点|とくてん}{差|さ}: point difference

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {点|てん}を{取|と}る: to get points — more casual, commonly used in everyday speech
- {得点|とくてん}を{入|い}れる: to put in a score — used in sports commentary
- ゴールする: to score a goal — specific to goal-based sports like soccer
